title: Fatal Fury: King of Fighters
shortDescription: Fatal Fury: King of Fighters helps define a Super Nintendo Entertainment System fighting path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Keeps a documented fighting option visible in the Super Nintendo Entertainment System collection.
Separates the GameAtlas catalog method from the external factual reference.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Recorded for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System fighting discovery path using a source-linked Wikidata item; this remains a catalog entry with its source kept explicit.
